draft.emotion: warm and comforting, expressing deep affection and care
notes: Literally 'to put to the neck/throat'. It is transitive (takes ने in the past), and the person or thing embraced is marked with को (ko).
Compare with गले मिलना (gale milnā, to hug each other), which is intransitive and takes से (se).
